title: NIDS and HIDS: a sensor on the network and a sensor on the host

videos.script: A sensor on the network sees every conversation, and nothing inside the machines. A sensor on a host sees one machine closely, and nothing else. {{two}} In this lesson a stranger asks for the shop's admin page twice. Once in plain HTTP, once over HTTPS. The network sensor catches the first and cannot read the second. The shop's own log has both. {{blind}} Then the host watches itself. A file integrity check notices a change to the proxy's configuration, and a comparison of open ports finds a program that has no business there. {{host}} Last, why the two views are worth most together, and why a host's records have to leave the host. {{together}}
